title: A first toast in Kuyavia: New evidence for drinking rituals in Neolithic Europe from Sławęcinek, Poland
lineage: Cited passage inspected; retained file is a brief paraphrased research note.

passages.locator: Further evidence for earliest wheeled transport in Europe
passages.note: Authors discuss four-wheeled wagon imagery on the Bronocice pot and report associated radiocarbon determination GrN-19612 as 3635–3370 cal BCE at 94.5% probability; interpretation of marks and dating are archaeological inferences.
